description: Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin and Rankine with live sync.

faqs.a: Multiply Celsius by 9/5 and add 32. For example, 20 °C × 9/5 + 32 = 68 °F.
faqs.q: What is the formula for Celsius to Fahrenheit?

faqs.a: Both scales start at absolute zero. Rankine = Kelvin × 9/5, so 273.15 K equals 491.67 °R.
faqs.q: How do Kelvin and Rankine relate to each other?

faqs.a: The converter still does the math, but it warns you: nothing can be colder than −273.15 °C (0 K / 0 °R).
faqs.q: Can I enter a temperature below absolute zero?

howto: Type a temperature into any one of the four fields.
The other three units update instantly as you type.
Clear the field to reset all four values.
Values below absolute zero (−273.15 °C) are flagged as physically impossible.
